How can we
pray with you?

You are welcome to share a prayer request with HCTM. Tell us what you would like prayer for, sharing only the details you are comfortable providing.

A simple way to reach us

Write your request below, then continue to WhatsApp. You will review it there and choose whether to send it.

Or open a direct WhatsApp conversation (opens in a new tab) without writing here.

Please avoid passwords, bank details, medical records, and private information about other people.

Read our privacy notice

This page does not send or store your request. Continuing puts your text into a WhatsApp link so you can review it before sending. WhatsApp handles the next step.
